","data:image/webp;base64,"];
const ROMAN=['I','II','III','IV','V','VI','VII','VIII','IX','X','XI','XII','XIII','XIV'];
const MODE_KEY='ao.stations-sacred-art.mode.v1';
const RESUME_KEY='ao.stations.session.v1';
const LANDING_INDEX=1; // Station II — Christ takes up His Cross.
let queued=false,wrapped=false,artToken=0;
const pb=()=>window.AOTraditionalPrayerBook;
const root=()=>document.getElementById('aoPrayerBookRoot');
const state=()=>pb()?.getState?.()||null;
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[c]));
function mode(){try{const v=localStorage.getItem(MODE_KEY);return ['on','subtle','off'].includes(v)?v:'on'}catch{return'on'}}
function setMode(v){v=['on','subtle','off'].includes(v)?v:'on';try{localStorage.setItem(MODE_KEY,v)}catch{}schedule();return v}
function saveResume(n){n=Math.trunc(Number(n)||0);try{if(n>=1&&n<=14)localStorage.setItem(RESUME_KEY,String(n));else localStorage.removeItem(RESUME_KEY)}catch{}}
function loadResume(){try{const n=Math.trunc(Number(localStorage.getItem(RESUME_KEY))||0);return n>=1&&n<=14?n:0}catch{return 0}}
function clearResume(){saveResume(0)}
function preload(index){if(index<0||index>=ART.length)return;try{const im=new Image();im.decoding='async';im.src=ART[index];if(im.decode)im.decode().catch(()=>{})}catch{}}
function cleanup(shell){if(!shell)return;shell.querySelectorAll('.aoV4311StationsArt').forEach(x=>x.remove())}
function makeFigure(index,title,landing=false){
 const fig=document.createElement('figure');fig.className='aoV4311StationsArt'+(landing?' aoV4311StationsLandingArt':'')+(mode()==='subtle'?' is-subtle':'');
 const stationNo=index+1,caption=landing?(document.documentElement.lang?.toLowerCase().startsWith('fr')?'Chemin de Croix':'Stations of the Cross'):`${ROMAN[index]} · ${title||''}`;
 const meditation=document.documentElement.lang?.toLowerCase().startsWith('fr')?'Méditation par l’art sacré':'Sacred art meditation';
 fig.innerHTML=`<img alt="${esc(landing?(document.documentElement.lang?.toLowerCase().startsWith('fr')?'Le Christ prend sa Croix':'Christ takes up His Cross'):(`Station ${stationNo} — ${title||''}`))}" src="${ART[index]}" decoding="async"><figcaption><span>${esc(caption)}</span><span>${meditation}</span></figcaption>`;
 const img=fig.querySelector('img'),token=++artToken;
 img.addEventListener('error',()=>{if(token===artToken)fig.remove()},{once:true});
 return fig;
}
function applyArt(){
 const r=root(),s=state();if(!r||s?.view!=='stations')return;
 const shell=r.querySelector('.pbShell[data-rc2-module="stations"]')||r.querySelector('.pbShell');if(!shell)return;
 cleanup(shell);if(mode()==='off')return;
 const n=Math.trunc(Number(s.station)||0);
 if(n===0){const hero=shell.querySelector('.lab-stations-hero');if(!hero)return;hero.prepend(makeFigure(LANDING_INDEX,'',true));preload(0);return}
 if(n<1||n>14)return;
 const idx=n-1,card=shell.querySelector('.lab-station-text');if(!card)return;
 const title=card.querySelector('h2')?.textContent?.trim()||'';
 card.insertAdjacentElement('beforebegin',makeFigure(idx,title,false));
 preload(idx+1);
}
function enhancePrefs(){
 const sheet=document.getElementById('rc2-module-sheet'),body=sheet?.querySelector('.rc2SheetBody');if(!body||!sheet.querySelector('[data-rc2-station-mode]')||body.querySelector('.aoV4311StationsArtPref'))return;
 const fr=(document.documentElement.lang||'').toLowerCase().startsWith('fr')||/Présentation du Chemin/.test(body.textContent||''),m=mode();
 const sec=document.createElement('section');sec.className='rc2PrefSection aoV4311StationsArtPref';
 sec.innerHTML=`<h3>${fr?'Art sacré':'Sacred art'}</h3><p>${fr?'Choisissez comment l’image de chaque Station accompagne la méditation.':'Choose how each Station image accompanies the meditation.'}</p><div class="rc2Segments three">${[['on',fr?'Activé':'On'],['subtle',fr?'Discret':'Subtle'],['off',fr?'Désactivé':'Off']].map(([v,l])=>`<button type="button" class="${m===v?'active':''}" data-v4311-station-art="${v}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
 const first=body.querySelector('.rc2PrefSection');first?.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',sec)||body.prepend(sec);
}
function enhance(){queued=false;applyArt();enhancePrefs()}
function schedule(){if(queued)return;queued=true;requestAnimationFrame(enhance)}
function restoreSavedStation(){
 const target=loadResume();if(!target)return schedule();
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>{let guard=0;while(guard++<target){const s=state();if((Number(s?.station)||0)>=target)break;const b=root()?.querySelector('[data-pb-station-next]');if(!b)break;b.click()}schedule()});
}
function wrapPrayerBook(){
 if(wrapped||!pb()?.openModule)return false;wrapped=true;const api=pb(),orig=api.openModule.bind(api);
 api.openModule=(id,opts={})=>{const result=orig(id,opts);if(id==='stations')restoreSavedStation();return result};
 api.getStationsArtState=()=>({station:Number(state()?.station)||0,artMode:mode(),resume:loadResume()});
 return true;
}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 const art=e.target.closest?.('[data-v4311-station-art]');if(art){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();setMode(art.dataset.v4311StationArt);document.getElementById('rc2-module-sheet')?.remove();setTimeout(()=>{window.AO_RC2_MODULE_UX?.openPreferences?.('stations');setTimeout(enhancePrefs,0)},0);return}
 const next=e.target.closest?.('[data-pb-station-next]');if(next){const before=Number(state()?.station)||0;if(before>=14)clearResume();setTimeout(()=>{const after=Number(state()?.station)||0;if(before<14)saveResume(after);schedule()},0)}
 const prev=e.target.closest?.('[data-pb-station-prev]');if(prev)setTimeout(()=>{const after=Number(state()?.station)||0;saveResume(after);schedule()},0);
 if(e.target.closest?.('[data-pb-station-mode],[data-rc2-station-mode],[data-rc2-prefs="stations"]'))setTimeout(()=>{schedule();enhancePrefs()},0);
},true);
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.closest?.('[data-pb-stabat],[data-rc2-toggle="stationStabat"]'))setTimeout(schedule,0)},true);
function install(){wrapPrayerBook();schedule();if(!wrapped)setTimeout(install,60)}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});else install();
window.addEventListener('pageshow',()=>{wrapPrayerBook();schedule()});
window.AO_STATIONS_ART_V4311=Object.freeze({
 version:VERSION,count:14,landingStation:2,source:'approved 2026-09-19 stained-glass XIV cycle',embedded:true,width:1086,height:1448,
 getMode:mode,setMode,resume:loadResume,clearResume,sync:schedule,
 inspect:()=>{const s=state(),r=root(),n=Number(s?.station)||0,figs=r?.querySelectorAll('.aoV4311StationsArt').length||0;return{version:VERSION,station:n,mode:mode(),resume:loadResume(),figures:figs,expectedFigure:(s?.view==='stations'&&mode()!=='off')?1:0,pass:ART.length===14&&(!s||s.view!=='stations'||mode()==='off'||figs===1)}}
});
try{document.title='Ad Orientem 2.0 · v43.11 · Stations Sacred Art Integration';document.documentElement.dataset.aoRelease='43.11'}catch{}
})();
</script>
<script id="ao-v4311-stations-sacred-art-meta">
window.AO_V4311_STATIONS_META=Object.freeze({version:'43.11',base:'v43.10-RULE-HERO-REUSE',lane:'stations-sacred-art',stationCount:14,landingHero:'Station II',delivery:'embedded full-dimension WebP + next-station decode prefetch',resume:true,failClosed:true,olderMixedStationsArtUsed:false});
</script>
<script id="ao-v4312-cinematic-loading-js">
(()=>{'use strict';
const VERSION='43.12-ZERO-OBSERVER-CINEMATIC-CERTIFICATION';
const q=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s);
const bootEl=()=>q('#ao-cinema-boot');
const transitionEl=()=>q('#ao-cinema-transition');
const loaderEl=()=>q('#ao-cinema-loader');
const runtime=()=>globalThis.AO_RUNTIME_V8||null;
const state=()=>runtime()?.store?.getState?.()||null;
const fr=()=>state()?.language==='fr';
const L=(en,frText)=>fr()?frText:en;
const systemReduced=()=>!!globalThis.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')?.matches;
const reduced=()=>systemReduced()||!!state()?.settings?.reducedMotion;
const routeMeta={
 'enter-live':()=>({kicker:'AD ORIENTEM',title:L('Entering Mass','Entrée dans la Messe')}),
 'leave-live':()=>({kicker:'AD ORIENTEM',title:L('Returning home','Retour à l’accueil')}),
 'enter-prepare':()=>({kicker:L('BEFORE MASS','AVANT LA MESSE'),title:L('Preparation for Mass','Préparation à la Messe')}),
 'leave-prepare':()=>({kicker:'AD ORIENTEM',title:L('Returning home','Retour à l’accueil')}),
 'enter-thanksgiving':()=>({kicker:L('AFTER MASS','APRÈS LA MESSE'),title:L('Thanksgiving','Action de grâce')}),
 'finish-live':()=>({kicker:L('AFTER MASS','APRÈS LA MESSE'),title:L('Thanksgiving','Action de grâce')}),
 'leave-thanksgiving':()=>({kicker:'AD ORIENTEM',title:L('Returning home','Retour à l’accueil')}),
 'scripture-open':()=>({kicker:L('SACRED SCRIPTURE','SAINTE ÉCRITURE'),title:L('Opening the reading','Ouverture de la lecture')}),
 'scripture-close':()=>({kicker:'AD ORIENTEM',title:L('Returning','Retour')})
};
let transitionTimer=0,loaderTimer=0,loaderHideTimer=0,bootFinished=false,storeInstalled=false,lastLoadingKey='';
function sceneIn(){const app=q('#app');if(!app||reduced())return;app.classList.remove('aoCinemaSceneEnter');void app.offsetWidth;app.classList.add('aoCinemaSceneEnter');setTimeout(()=>app.classList.remove('aoCinemaSceneEnter'),620)}
function showTransition(meta){
 const el=transitionEl();if(!el||reduced()||bootEl()?.classList.contains('aoCinemaBootDone')===false)return;
 clearTimeout(transitionTimer);q('[data-ao-cinema-transition-kicker]',el).textContent=meta.kicker||'AD ORIENTEM';q('[data-ao-cinema-transition-title]',el).textContent=meta.title||'';el.classList.remove('aoCinemaTransitionOut');el.classList.add('aoCinemaTransitionOn');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(sceneIn));
 transitionTimer=setTimeout(()=>{el.classList.remove('aoCinemaTransitionOn');el.classList.add('aoCinemaTransitionOut');transitionTimer=setTimeout(()=>{el.classList.remove('aoCinemaTransitionOut');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')},520)},Math.max(260,meta.hold||360));
}
function contentLoadingSpec(s){if(!s)return null;if(s.resolving)return {key:'calendar',title:L('Resolving the 1962 calendar','Résolution du calendrier de 1962'),sub:L('Selecting the proper Mass and liturgical colour','Sélection de la Messe et de la couleur liturgique')};if(s.scripture?.loading)return {key:'scripture',title:L('Opening Sacred Scripture','Ouverture de la Sainte Écriture'),sub:L('Loading the appointed reading and commentary','Chargement de la lecture et du commentaire')};return null}
function hideLoader(){clearTimeout(loaderTimer);lastLoadingKey='';const el=loaderEl();if(!el)return;clearTimeout(loaderHideTimer);el.classList.remove('aoCinemaLoaderOn');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')}
function scheduleLoader(spec){
 if(!spec){hideLoader();return}if(bootEl()&&!bootEl().classList.contains('aoCinemaBootDone'))return;if(lastLoadingKey===spec.key&&loaderEl()?.classList.contains('aoCinemaLoaderOn'))return;lastLoadingKey=spec.key;clearTimeout(loaderTimer);loaderTimer=setTimeout(()=>{const current=contentLoadingSpec(state());if(!current||current.key!==spec.key)return;const el=loaderEl();if(!el)return;q('[data-ao-cinema-loader-title]',el).textContent=current.title;q('[data-ao-cinema-loader-sub]',el).textContent=current.sub;el.classList.add('aoCinemaLoaderOn');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false')},220)}
function syncLoading(s=state()){const spec=contentLoadingSpec(s);if(spec)scheduleLoader(spec);else hideLoader()}
function installStore(){
 const store=runtime()?.store;if(!store?.dispatch||!store?.subscribe||storeInstalled)return !!storeInstalled;storeInstalled=true;
 const original=store.dispatch.bind(store);store.dispatch=(action)=>{const type=action?.type,make=routeMeta[type];if(make)showTransition(make());const result=original(action);syncLoading(store.getState());queuePresentationScan();return result};
 store.subscribe(s=>{document.documentElement.dataset.aoCinemaRoute=s?.route||'';document.documentElement.dataset.reducedMotion=String(!!s?.settings?.reducedMotion);syncLoading(s);queuePresentationScan()});syncLoading(store.getState());queuePresentationScan();return true
}
function finishBoot(reason='ready'){
 if(bootFinished)return;bootFinished=true;const el=bootEl();if(!el)return;const s=state(),status=q('[data-ao-cinema-boot-status]',el),title=s?.resolution?.proper?.data?.name||s?.resolution?.day?.main?.title||'';if(status){status.textContent=title?L(`${title} · Ready`,`${title} · Prêt`):L('Ready','Prêt');status.classList.add('ready')}
 const delay=reduced()?0:260;setTimeout(()=>{el.classList.add('aoCinemaBootDone');el.dataset.reason=reason;setTimeout(()=>{el.remove();syncLoading(state())},reduced()?0:720)},delay)
}
function bootWatch(){
 const started=performance.now();let stable=0;const tick=()=>{installStore();const s=state(),home=q('.homeScreen'),ready=!!(s&&home&&!s.resolving&&s.resolution);if(ready)stable++;else stable=0;if(stable>=2){finishBoot('home-ready');return}if(performance.now()-started>5200){finishBoot('guard-timeout');return}requestAnimationFrame(tick)};requestAnimationFrame(tick)
}
const ART_SELECTORS=['.aoProperArt img','.aoRuleModuleHero img','.aoV401RosaryHero img','.aoSaintArtCard img','.aoSaintReaderMedia img','[data-ao-proper-art] img','.aoV4311StationsArt img'];
function artCandidate(img){return img instanceof HTMLImageElement&&ART_SELECTORS.some(sel=>img.matches(sel))}
function prepArt(img){if(!artCandidate(img)||img.dataset.aoCinemaImage==='1')return;img.dataset.aoCinemaImage='1';const host=img.parentElement;if(host)host.classList.add('aoCinemaArt');const ready=()=>{img.classList.remove('aoCinemaImagePending','aoCinemaImageError');img.classList.add('aoCinemaImageReady');host?.classList.remove('aoCinemaArt')};const fail=()=>{img.classList.remove('aoCinemaImagePending');img.classList.add('aoCinemaImageError');host?.classList.remove('aoCinemaArt')};if(img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0){if(reduced()){ready();return}img.classList.add('aoCinemaImagePending');requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(ready));return}img.classList.add('aoCinemaImagePending');img.addEventListener('load',ready,{once:true});img.addEventListener('error',fail,{once:true})}
function scanArt(root=document){if(root instanceof HTMLImageElement)prepArt(root);root.querySelectorAll?.(ART_SELECTORS.join(',')).forEach(prepArt)}
function surfaceCandidate(el){if(!(el instanceof HTMLElement)||el.dataset.aoCinemaSurface==='1')return false;return el.matches('.homeSheetBackdrop,.rc2SheetBackdrop,.flowGuideOverlay,#aoPrayerBookRoot,.aoSaintReaderBackdrop,.aoAuditBackdrop')||!!el.querySelector?.('.homeSheet,.rc2Sheet')}
function prepSurface(el){if(!surfaceCandidate(el))return;el.dataset.aoCinemaSurface='1';if(!reduced()){el.classList.add('aoCinemaSurfaceIn');setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('aoCinemaSurfaceIn'),520)}}
const SURFACE_SELECTOR='.homeSheetBackdrop,.rc2SheetBackdrop,.flowGuideOverlay,#aoPrayerBookRoot,.aoSaintReaderBackdrop,.aoAuditBackdrop';
let presentationScanQueued=false,presentationScanTimer=0;
function scanPresentation(root=document){scanArt(root);if(root instanceof HTMLElement)prepSurface(root);root.querySelectorAll?.(SURFACE_SELECTOR).forEach(prepSurface)}
function queuePresentationScan(){
 if(!presentationScanQueued){presentationScanQueued=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{presentationScanQueued=false;scanPresentation()})}
 clearTimeout(presentationScanTimer);presentationScanTimer=setTimeout(scanPresentation,180)
}
function installPresentationHooks(){
 scanPresentation();
 document.addEventListener('click',()=>queuePresentationScan(),true);
 document.addEventListener('change',()=>queuePresentationScan(),true);
 document.addEventListener('submit',()=>queuePresentationScan(),true)
}
function init(){
 document.documentElement.dataset.aoCinematic=VERSION;installPresentationHooks();bootWatch();const wait=setInterval(()=>{if(installStore())clearInterval(wait)},40);setTimeout(()=>clearInterval(wait),6000);
 const api=Object.freeze({version:VERSION,showTransition,finishBoot,scanArt,scanPresentation,queuePresentationScan,isReducedMotion:reduced,observerFree:true});globalThis.AO_CINEMATIC_V4312=api;globalThis.AO_CINEMATIC_V4311=api
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
</script>

<script id="ao-v4312-harmonized-certification-meta">

 const observerCount=()=>[...document.scripts].reduce((n,s)=>n+(s.textContent.match(/new\s+MutationObserver\s*\(/g)||[]).length,0);

 window.AO_V4312_META=Object.freeze({version:V,title:T,lane:'harmonized-mass-certification',massStudyBase:'v43.9',ruleHeroBase:'v43.11-rule-rosary-madonna',stationsArt:'v43.11',sacredArtGate:'v43.10',cinematic:'v43.12-observer-free',cueEngine:'25.5',observerFree:true,inspect});document.title=T;document.documentElement.dataset.aoRelease=V;
})();
</script>

gestureForm=SIGN_CROSS_GOSPEL","to":"GOSPEL_CROSSES_3","severity":"semantic_cleanup"},{"record":"palms-gospel:1:gospel_crosses_3","from":"PERIOD_1962_GUIDE","to":"ESTABLISHED_LAY_CUSTOM","severity":"authority_normalization"},{"record":"second-confiteor:1:breast_strike_3","from":"PRE_1962_ONLY","to":"OLDER_CUSTOM_NON_NORMATIVE_1962","severity":"authority_normalization"},{"record":"second-confiteor:2:sign_of_cross","from":"PRE_1962_ONLY","to":"OLDER_CUSTOM_NON_NORMATIVE_1962","severity":"authority_normalization"},{"record":"preface:1:head_bow","from":"traditional_faithful_custom","to":"ESTABLISHED_LAY_CUSTOM","severity":"authority_normalization"}],"orphaned_fixed_records":[],"duplicate_ids":[],"notes":["Existing live UI remains unchanged; the normalized registry is attached to the current cue engine as a canonical data API.","Generic raw kind=cross remains supported for renderer compatibility; canonical action semantics distinguish full cross from three small Gospel crosses.","Ordinary congregational posture records in the current Mass dataset already use local/custom policy; the registry adds profile defaults and authority rather than overriding that policy."],"pass":true}};
const clone=v=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
function celebrationCode(blob){
  const s=String(blob||'');
  if(/annunciation|annuntiat|25[- /]03|03[- /]25/i.test(s)) return 'ANNUNCIATION';
  if(/christmas|nativity of (?:our )?lord|nativitas domini|25[- /]12|12[- /]25/i.test(s)) return 'CHRISTMAS';
  return 'OTHER';
}
function contextFromRuntime(extra={}){
  const st=globalThis.AO_RUNTIME_V8?.store?.getState?.()||{};
  const live=st.live||{};
  const active=globalThis.AO_ACTIVE_MASS_SESSION||{};
  const title=String(active?.proper?.title||active?.resolvedMass?.title||st?.resolution?.day?.main?.title||'');
  const proper=String(active?.resolvedMass?.properSource||active?.proper?.sourcePath||st?.resolution?.day?.selectedMassOption?.path||st?.resolution?.day?.main?.path||'');
  const settings=st.settings||{};
  const out={
    form:String(live.form||settings.massForm||'low').toUpperCase(),
    requiem:/requiem|defunct|dead|missa pro defunctis/i.test(title+' '+proper),
    celebration:title,
    celebrationCode:celebrationCode(title+' '+proper),
    properPath:proper,
    secondConfiteor:!!settings.secondConfiteor
  };
  return Object.assign(out,extra||{});
}
function postureFor(stepId,ctx={}){
  const c=contextFromRuntime(ctx);
  const group=DATA.step_to_posture_group[stepId];
  const p=group?DATA.posture_groups[group]:null;
  if(!p) return null;
  if(c.requiem&&group==='blessing') return null;
  const form=String(c.form||'LOW').toLowerCase();
  const action=p[form]||p.default||'FOLLOW_LOCAL_CUSTOM';
  return {group,action,authority:p.authority,localOverride:true};
}
function recordSuppressed(rec,c){
  if(rec.step==='second-confiteor'&&!c.secondConfiteor) return true;
  if(c.requiem&&rec.step==='agnus'&&rec.action==='BREAST_STRIKE_3') return true;
  if(c.requiem&&rec.step==='blessing') return true;
  return false;
}
function variantMatches(v,c){
  const w=v?.when||{};
  if(w.form&&String(c.form).toUpperCase()!==String(w.form).toUpperCase()) return false;
  if(Array.isArray(w.celebration_group)&&w.celebration_group.length&&!w.celebration_group.includes(c.celebrationCode)) return false;
  return true;
}
function resolvedRecord(rec,c){
  const out=clone(rec);
  for(const v of (out.conditional_variants||[])){
    if(!variantMatches(v,c)) continue;
    out.action=v.action||out.action;
    out.authority=v.authority||out.authority;
    out.sourceRefs=v.sourceRefs||out.sourceRefs;
    const label=DATA.authority_labels[out.authority];
    if(label&&out.guide){out.guide.status_en=label.en;out.guide.status_fr=label.fr;out.guide.sources=out.sourceRefs;}
    if(out.action==='KNEEL'&&out.step==='credo'){
      out.guide=Object.assign({},DATA.guide_library.KNEEL,{
        status_en:label?.en||'1962 rubric',
        status_fr:label?.fr||'Rubrique de 1962',
        sources:out.sourceRefs,
        action_en:'At a Sung Mass on Christmas or the Annunciation, kneel at Et incarnatus est and remain kneeling through et homo factus est.',
        action_fr:'À une Messe chantée de Noël ou de l’Annonciation, se mettre à genoux à Et incarnatus est et rester à genoux jusqu’à et homo factus est.',
        why_en:'This is the specific 1962 Incarnation exception; the ordinary genuflection becomes kneeling at these sung celebrations.',
        why_fr:'C’est l’exception propre de 1962 pour l’Incarnation ; la génuflexion ordinaire devient une posture à genoux lors de ces célébrations chantées.'
      });
    }
    break;
  }
  return out;
}
function gesturesFor(stepId,ctx={}){
  const c=contextFromRuntime(ctx);
  return DATA.fixed_gestures.filter(r=>r.step===stepId&&!recordSuppressed(r,c)).map(r=>resolvedRecord(r,c));
}
function guideFor(record,lang='en'){
  if(!record) return null;
  const g=record.guide||DATA.guide_library[record.action]||{};
  const sourceRefs=record.sourceRefs||g.sources||[];
  return {
    action:g[lang==='fr'?'action_fr':'action_en']||'',
    status:g[lang==='fr'?'status_fr':'status_en']||DATA.authority_labels[record.authority]?.[lang]||record.authority,
    why:g[lang==='fr'?'why_fr':'why_en']||'',
    sources:sourceRefs.map(id=>DATA.source_registry[id]).filter(Boolean)
  };
}
function resolveGuidance(stepId,ctx={}){
  const c=contextFromRuntime(ctx);
  const gestures=gesturesFor(stepId,c);
  return {
    step:stepId,
    context:c,
    posture:postureFor(stepId,c),
    gestures,
    guides:gestures.map(r=>guideFor(r,'en')),
    dynamicRules:DATA.dynamic_gestures,
    suppressions:DATA.suppressions
  };
}
function inspect(){
  const old=globalThis.AO_INLINE_CUES_V251;
  const checks=Object.assign({},DATA.audit.checks,{
    cueEngineAttached:!!old,
    cueEngineVersion:old?.version==='25.5',
    normalizedRegistryPass:DATA.audit.pass,
    gospelResolverSemantic:gesturesFor('gospel-announcement',{form:'LOW'}).some(x=>x.action==='GOSPEL_CROSSES_3'),
    noElevationResolverCross:gesturesFor('consecration-host',{form:'LOW'}).every(x=>x.action!=='SIGN_OF_CROSS'),
    requiemAgnusResolverSuppressed:gesturesFor('agnus',{form:'LOW',requiem:true}).every(x=>x.action!=='BREAST_STRIKE_3'),
    secondConfiteorResolverOff:gesturesFor('second-confiteor',{form:'LOW',secondConfiteor:false}).length===0,
    incarnationResolverKneels:gesturesFor('credo',{form:'SUNG',celebrationCode:'ANNUNCIATION'}).some(x=>x.action==='KNEEL')
  });
  return {version:DATA.version,pass:Object.values(checks).every(Boolean),checks,counts:{
    fixedGestures:DATA.fixed_gestures.length,
    dynamicRules:DATA.dynamic_gestures.length,
    postureGroups:Object.keys(DATA.posture_groups).length
  }};
}
const API=Object.freeze({
  version:DATA.version,data:DATA,contextFromRuntime,postureFor,gesturesFor,guideFor,resolveGuidance,inspect
});
globalThis.AO_MASS_GUIDANCE_V4313=API;
if(globalThis.AO_INLINE_CUES_V251){
  globalThis.AO_INLINE_CUES_V251.guidanceRegistryVersion=DATA.version;
  globalThis.AO_INLINE_CUES_V251.massGuidance=API;
  globalThis.AO_INLINE_CUES_V251.resolveGuidance=resolveGuidance;
}
globalThis.AO_V4313_GUIDANCE_CERT=inspect();
})();
</script>
<script id="ao-v4313-release-authority-js">
(()=>{const V='43.13',T='Ad Orientem 2.0 v43.13 — Mass Guidance Registry';const g=globalThis.AO_MASS_GUIDANCE_V4313;const report=g?.inspect?.()||{pass:false};globalThis.AO_V4313_META=Object.freeze({version:V,title:T,lane:'mass-guidance-registry',base:'v43.12',cueEngine:'25.5',guidanceRegistry:'43.13',pass:!!report.pass,inspect:()=>g?.inspect?.()||report});document.title=T;document.documentElement.dataset.aoRelease=V;})();
</script>

<style id="ao-v4314-mass-formation-guides-css">
.aoGuidanceWhy h3{margin:0 0 8px;font:600 .72rem/1.2 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--liturgical)}
.aoGuideFacts,.aoLearnGuideFacts{display:grid;gap:7px}.aoGuideFact,.aoLearnGuideFact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 10px;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.022)}
.aoGuideFact b,.aoLearnGuideFact b{color:var(--liturgical);font:600 .62rem/1.2 var(--font-display);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em}.aoGuideFact span,.aoLearnGuideFact span{color:var(--text);font-size:.9rem}.aoGuideFact small,.aoLearnGuideFact small{grid-column:2;color:var(--muted-2);font-size:.72rem}.aoGuideFact em,.aoLearnGuideFact em{font-family:var(--font-liturgical);font-style:italic}
.aoCueStudy{width:100%;min-height:44px;margin:4px 0 14px;border:1px solid var(--liturgical-border);border-radius:11px;background:var(--liturgical-soft);color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.aoCueGuideSources small{display:block;color:var(--liturgical);font-size:.6rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:2px}
.aoInterpretiveNote{display:block;margin-top:8px;color:var(--muted-2);font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.4}.aoLearnGuidance{border-color:var(--liturgical-border)!important;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--liturgical-soft),var(--surface-1))!important}
</style>
<script id="ao-v4314-mass-formation-guides-js">
(()=>{'use strict';
const NOTES={"sign-cross":{"spiritual_en":"The opening invocation places the whole action under the Trinity and Christ’s Passion. Traditional writers treat it as a deliberate recollection: worship begins by belonging to God before anything is asked or offered.","spiritual_fr":"L’invocation initiale place toute l’action sous la Trinité et la Passion du Christ. Les auteurs spirituels traditionnels y voient un acte de recueillement : le culte commence par l’appartenance à Dieu avant toute demande ou offrande.","participation_en":"At Sung Mass the Introit may overlap with the Prayers at the Foot. When the Sunday Asperges precedes the principal Mass, the Introit begins only after the sprinkling rite concludes.","participation_fr":"À la Messe chantée, l’Introït peut se superposer aux prières au bas de l’autel. Lorsque l’aspersion dominicale précède la Messe principale, l’Introït ne commence qu’après la conclusion du rite d’aspersion.","sources":["gueranger","alphonsus"]},"judica":{"spiritual_en":"The psalm gives the approach to the altar the language of desire, trial and confidence. Guéranger’s spiritual reading is especially useful here: the ascent toward the altar is first an interior movement toward God.","spiritual_fr":"Le psaume donne à l’approche de l’autel le langage du désir, de l’épreuve et de la confiance. La lecture spirituelle de Guéranger est particulièrement utile ici : la montée vers l’autel est d’abord un mouvement intérieur vers Dieu.","variation_en":"Omitted in Masses for the Dead and from Passion Sunday through Holy Saturday under the 1962 order.","variation_fr":"Omis aux Messes des défunts et du dimanche de la Passion au Samedi saint selon l’ordo de 1962.","sources":["gueranger"]},"ministers-confiteor":{"spiritual_en":"The triple breast strike externalizes contrition without pretending that the liturgical Confiteor replaces sacramental confession. The bodily gesture serves humility; it is not theatrical self-accusation.","spiritual_fr":"Les trois coups sur la poitrine extériorisent la contrition sans laisser croire que le Confiteor liturgique remplace la confession sacramentelle. Le geste corporel sert l’humilité ; il n’est pas une mise en scène de l’auto-accusation.","participation_en":"At mea culpa, mea culpa, mea maxima culpa, strike the breast three times according to established traditional practice.","participation_fr":"À mea culpa, mea culpa, mea maxima culpa, frappez la poitrine trois fois selon l’usage traditionnel établi.","sources":["alphonsus","gueranger"]},"introit":{"spiritual_en":"The Proper does more than provide an entrance text: it gives the particular Mass its scriptural voice. Let the Introit identify the day before treating it as background music.","spiritual_fr":"Le Propre ne fournit pas seulement un chant d’entrée : il donne à cette Messe sa voix scripturaire propre. Laissez l’Introït identifier le jour avant de le traiter comme simple musique de fond.","variation_en":"At Sung Mass the schola’s Introit and the priest’s preparatory prayers may proceed simultaneously.","variation_fr":"À la Messe chantée, l’Introït de la schola et les prières préparatoires du prêtre peuvent se dérouler simultanément.","sources":["gueranger"]},"kyrie":{"spiritual_en":"The repeated cry for mercy is deliberately simple. Traditional ascetical writers use it to move from self-knowledge to confident appeal rather than to anxiety.","spiritual_fr":"L’appel répété à la miséricorde est volontairement simple. Les auteurs ascétiques traditionnels l’emploient pour passer de la connaissance de soi à une supplication confiante plutôt qu’à l’anxiété.","sources":["alphonsus"]},"gloria":{"spiritual_en":"The Gloria moves from the angelic hymn into adoration, thanksgiving and supplication. Its bodily reverences sit inside a text whose dominant character is praise.","spiritual_fr":"Le Gloria passe du chant des anges à l’adoration, l’action de grâces et la supplication. Ses révérences corporelles s’inscrivent dans un texte dominé par la louange.","variation_en":"Congregational standing/sitting during a long Sung Gloria follows local custom; the exact textual bows remain separate from that posture choice.","variation_fr":"La station debout ou assise des fidèles pendant un long Gloria chanté relève de l’usage local ; les inclinations textuelles précises restent indépendantes de ce choix de posture.","sources":["gueranger"]},"collect":{"spiritual_en":"The Collect gathers the Church’s prayer into one appointed petition. The faithful need not invent a parallel private intention at every Collect; they can unite themselves to the prayer the celebrant pronounces for the Church.","spiritual_fr":"La Collecte rassemble la prière de l’Église dans une supplication prescrite. Les fidèles n’ont pas à inventer une intention privée parallèle à chaque Collecte ; ils peuvent s’unir à la prière que le célébrant prononce pour l’Église.","sources":["gueranger"]},"epistle":{"spiritual_en":"Listening is itself participation here. The proper response is not to search for a gesture, but to receive the inspired lesson attentively.","spiritual_fr":"Écouter est ici une véritable participation. La réponse propre n’est pas de chercher un geste, mais de recevoir attentivement la leçon inspirée.","participation_en":"At Sung Mass sitting is the normal choir-derived reference posture; Low-Mass congregational practice varies locally.","participation_fr":"À la Messe chantée, la position assise est la référence dérivée de l’usage du chœur ; à la Messe basse, l’usage des fidèles varie localement.","sources":["gueranger"]},"gospel":{"spiritual_en":"The Gospel is honoured as the proclamation of Christ’s words and deeds. The bodily reverence at its announcement expresses receptivity to the Word proclaimed.","spiritual_fr":"L’Évangile est honoré comme proclamation des paroles et des actes du Christ. La révérence corporelle à son annonce exprime la disponibilité à recevoir la Parole proclamée.","participation_en":"Stand; bow at the Holy Name when it occurs in the public text.","participation_fr":"Tenez-vous debout ; inclinez la tête au Saint Nom lorsqu’il apparaît dans le texte public.","sources":["gueranger"]},"credo":{"spiritual_en":"The Creed is both confession and worship: the body marks key clauses because the faith professed is not merely an abstract list of propositions. The Incarnation receives the most pronounced bodily reverence.","spiritual_fr":"Le Credo est à la fois confession et culte : le corps marque certaines clauses parce que la foi professée n’est pas une simple liste abstraite de propositions. L’Incarnation reçoit la révérence corporelle la plus marquée.","variation_en":"Ordinarily genuflect at Et incarnatus est. At a Sung Mass on Christmas or the Annunciation, kneel through et homo factus est according to the specific 1962 rule.","variation_fr":"Ordinairement, faites une génuflexion à Et incarnatus est. À une Messe chantée de Noël ou de l’Annonciation, mettez-vous à genoux jusqu’à et homo factus est selon la règle particulière de 1962.","sources":["gueranger"]},"offertory":{"spiritual_en":"The Offertory begins the more immediate preparation of the matter of sacrifice. Traditional spiritual writers invite the faithful to unite themselves interiorly to the Church’s offering without pretending that they perform the priest’s sacramental acts.","spiritual_fr":"L’Offertoire commence la préparation plus immédiate de la matière du sacrifice. Les auteurs spirituels traditionnels invitent les fidèles à s’unir intérieurement à l’offrande de l’Église sans prétendre accomplir les actes sacramentels du prêtre.","sources":["gihr","gueranger","alphonsus"]},"lavabo":{"spiritual_en":"The washing is a ceremonial purification accompanied by Psalm 25. Its spiritual interpretation is straightforward: sacred ministry is approached with a prayer for interior purity as well as exterior order.","spiritual_fr":"Le lavement est une purification cérémonielle accompagnée du psaume 25. Son interprétation spirituelle est simple : le ministère sacré s’approche avec une prière de pureté intérieure autant qu’avec un ordre extérieur.","sources":["gueranger","gihr"]},"orate-fratres":{"spiritual_en":"The invitation makes explicit that the sacrifice offered by the priest is the Church’s sacrifice, to which the faithful unite their prayer and assent according to their own liturgical role.","spiritual_fr":"L’invitation manifeste que le sacrifice offert par le prêtre est le sacrifice de l’Église, auquel les fidèles unissent leur prière et leur assentiment selon leur propre rôle liturgique.","sources":["gihr"]},"secret":{"spiritual_en":"The quiet prayer intensifies the transition from the Offertory to the Eucharistic prayer. Silence here is not absence of action; the priest is praying the appointed proper prayer over the offerings.","spiritual_fr":"La prière dite à voix basse intensifie le passage de l’Offertoire à la prière eucharistique. Le silence n’est pas une absence d’action : le prêtre récite la prière propre prescrite sur les offrandes.","participation_en":"Use the audible conclusion Per omnia saecula saeculorum as an orientation landmark before the Preface.","participation_fr":"Utilisez la conclusion audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum comme repère avant la Préface.","sources":["gueranger"]},"preface":{"spiritual_en":"The dialogue deliberately lifts the heart before the great thanksgiving. Traditional commentary reads Sursum corda as an interior command to leave distraction and attend to the divine action now approaching its centre.","spiritual_fr":"Le dialogue élève délibérément le cœur avant la grande action de grâces. Le commentaire traditionnel lit Sursum corda comme un appel intérieur à quitter la distraction et à se rendre attentif à l’action divine qui approche de son centre.","sources":["gueranger","alphonsus"]},"sanctus":{"spiritual_en":"The Sanctus joins the Church’s earthly worship to the praise of heaven. The subsequent silence of the Canon should be understood as intensification, not interruption, of that worship.","spiritual_fr":"Le Sanctus unit le culte terrestre de l’Église à la louange du ciel. Le silence du Canon qui suit doit être compris comme une intensification, non une interruption, de ce culte.","variation_en":"Congregational posture at the Sanctus varies locally; the head bow at Sanctus is a separate momentary gesture.","variation_fr":"La posture des fidèles au Sanctus varie localement ; l’inclination à Sanctus est un geste momentané distinct.","sources":["gueranger"]},"te-igitur":{"spiritual_en":"The Canon opens with the sacrifice explicitly offered for the Church. The faithful’s role is recollected union, not vocal duplication of the priest’s silent text.","spiritual_fr":"Le Canon s’ouvre par l’offrande explicite du sacrifice pour l’Église. Le rôle des fidèles est l’union recueillie, non la répétition vocale du texte silencieux du prêtre.","participation_en":"Remain kneeling according to established traditional practice. Do not chase private priestly gestures with matching lay cues.","participation_fr":"Restez à genoux selon l’usage traditionnel établi. Ne cherchez pas à reproduire par des gestes de fidèles les gestes privés du prêtre.","sources":["gueranger","gihr"]},"memento-living":{"spiritual_en":"This is an appropriate place to remember living persons and intentions, but that recollection is devotional participation, not an additional rubric.","spiritual_fr":"C’est un moment approprié pour se souvenir des vivants et de ses intentions, mais ce recueillement relève de la participation dévotionnelle, non d’une rubrique supplémentaire.","sources":["gueranger"]},"consecration-host":{"spiritual_en":"At the words of institution the sacramental centre of the Mass is reached. Traditional spiritual writers direct attention toward adoration of Christ truly present, rather than multiplying private external gestures.","spiritual_fr":"Aux paroles de l’institution, le centre sacramentel de la Messe est atteint. Les auteurs spirituels traditionnels dirigent l’attention vers l’adoration du Christ réellement présent plutôt que vers la multiplication de gestes extérieurs privés.","participation_en":"Remain kneeling and adore.","participation_fr":"Restez à genoux et adorez.","sources":["gihr","gueranger","alphonsus"]},"consecration-chalice":{"spiritual_en":"The Consecration of the chalice completes the double consecration that sacramentally represents Christ’s sacrificial death. The faithful remain in adoration rather than copying the celebrant’s ceremonial gestures.","spiritual_fr":"La consécration du calice achève la double consécration qui représente sacramentellement la mort sacrificielle du Christ. Les fidèles demeurent dans l’adoration plutôt que de reproduire les gestes cérémoniels du célébrant.","participation_en":"Remain kneeling and adore.","participation_fr":"Restez à genoux et adorez.","sources":["gihr","gueranger"]},"memento-dead":{"spiritual_en":"The Canon explicitly remembers the departed. This is a natural moment to commend the faithful departed interiorly, while the priest continues the appointed prayer.","spiritual_fr":"Le Canon fait explicitement mémoire des défunts. C’est un moment naturel pour recommander intérieurement les fidèles défunts tandis que le prêtre poursuit la prière prescrite.","sources":["gueranger"]},"nobis-quoque":{"spiritual_en":"The single breast strike accompanies the plea that we sinners may receive some share with the saints. Its restraint matters: this is one strike, not another threefold Confiteor gesture.","spiritual_fr":"Le coup unique sur la poitrine accompagne la demande que nous, pécheurs, recevions une part avec les saints. Sa sobriété importe : il s’agit d’un seul coup, non d’un nouveau geste triple de Confiteor.","participation_en":"Strike the breast once at Nobis quoque peccatoribus according to established traditional lay participation.","participation_fr":"Frappez la poitrine une fois à Nobis quoque peccatoribus selon la participation traditionnelle établie.","sources":["gueranger"]},"pater":{"spiritual_en":"The Lord’s Prayer follows the Canon as the prayer taught by Christ and a direct preparation for Communion. The traditional Roman arrangement preserves distinct roles between celebrant and people even where the people answer the final petition.","spiritual_fr":"La prière du Seigneur suit le Canon comme prière enseignée par le Christ et préparation directe à la Communion. L’ordonnance romaine traditionnelle conserve des rôles distincts entre célébrant et fidèles même là où ceux-ci répondent à la dernière demande.","variation_en":"Lay posture during the Pater noster is highly dependent on local custom; do not convert a local pattern into a universal 1962 rule.","variation_fr":"La posture des fidèles pendant le Pater noster dépend fortement de l’usage local ; il ne faut pas transformer une pratique locale en règle universelle de 1962.","sources":["gueranger"]},"agnus":{"spiritual_en":"The three invocations address Christ as the sacrificial Lamb immediately before Communion. The ordinary three breast strikes express penitence and need for mercy and peace.","spiritual_fr":"Les trois invocations s’adressent au Christ comme Agneau sacrificiel immédiatement avant la Communion. Les trois coups ordinaires sur la poitrine expriment la pénitence et le besoin de miséricorde et de paix.","variation_en":"In a Requiem the text and ceremonial differ; suppress the ordinary breast-strike cue.","variation_fr":"Dans un Requiem, le texte et le cérémonial diffèrent ; le signal ordinaire des coups sur la poitrine est supprimé.","sources":["gueranger","alphonsus"]},"second-confiteor":{"spiritual_en":"Where an older custom retains this Confiteor, it can serve as immediate penitential preparation for Communion. But its devotional usefulness must not be confused with the normative 1962 order.","spiritual_fr":"Là où un usage ancien conserve ce Confiteor, il peut servir de préparation pénitentielle immédiate à la Communion. Mais son utilité dévotionnelle ne doit pas être confondue avec l’ordo normatif de 1962.","variation_en":"Default OFF. The 1962 rubrics omit the Confiteor and absolution immediately before Communion of the faithful; enable only as an explicitly older local/customary practice.","variation_fr":"Désactivé par défaut. Les rubriques de 1962 omettent le Confiteor et l’absolution immédiatement avant la Communion des fidèles ; ne l’activer que comme usage ancien/local explicitement identifié.","sources":["oconnell1964"]},"domine-non-sum-dignus":{"spiritual_en":"The repeated profession of unworthiness is not despair but confidence in the healing power of Christ’s word. The breast strikes give bodily form to that humility.","spiritual_fr":"La profession répétée d’indignité n’est pas du désespoir mais une confiance dans la puissance guérissante de la parole du Christ. Les coups sur la poitrine donnent une forme corporelle à cette humilité.","participation_en":"Strike the breast once with each of the three public repetitions before Communion of the faithful. Do not attach this lay cue to the priest’s earlier private prayer.","participation_fr":"Frappez la poitrine à chacune des trois répétitions publiques avant la Communion des fidèles. N’attachez pas ce geste de fidèles à la prière privée antérieure du prêtre.","sources":["alphonsus","gueranger"]},"communion-faithful":{"spiritual_en":"Reception is the sacramental culmination of the communicant’s participation, but the Mass is not reduced to receiving Communion. Traditional writers therefore join reverent reception to thanksgiving and continued attention to the liturgical action.","spiritual_fr":"La réception est l’aboutissement sacramentel de la participation du communiant, mais la Messe ne se réduit pas à recevoir la Communion. Les auteurs traditionnels unissent donc la réception révérente à l’action de grâces et à l’attention continue à l’action liturgique.","participation_en":"Follow the traditional discipline of the rite and the arrangements of the church. Ad Orientem does not instruct the communicant to answer Amen to the traditional Communion formula.","participation_fr":"Suivez la discipline traditionnelle du rite et les dispositions de l’église. Ad Orientem ne demande pas au communiant de répondre Amen à la formule traditionnelle de Communion.","sources":["alphonsus","gihr"]},"postcommunion":{"spiritual_en":"The Postcommunion asks that the sacrament received or the sacrifice celebrated bear fruit. It prevents thanksgiving from becoming purely private by returning it to the Church’s appointed prayer.","spiritual_fr":"La Postcommunion demande que le sacrement reçu ou le sacrifice célébré porte du fruit. Elle empêche l’action de grâces de devenir purement privée en la ramenant à la prière prescrite de l’Église.","sources":["gueranger"]},"super-populum":{"spiritual_en":"The Prayer over the People is a distinct blessing-like oration retained on the appropriate penitential days. Its presence is a property of the liturgical day, not a generic ending added to every Mass.","spiritual_fr":"L’Oraison sur le peuple est une oraison distincte, de caractère bénissant, conservée aux jours pénitentiels appropriés. Sa présence dépend du jour liturgique ; ce n’est pas une conclusion générique ajoutée à toute Messe.","variation_en":"Appears only where the 1962 Proper/ferial rules call for it.","variation_fr":"N’apparaît que lorsque les règles du Propre ou des féries de 1962 le prévoient.","sources":["mr1962","oconnell1964"]},"blessing":{"spiritual_en":"The blessing sends the faithful from the sacrifice under God’s benediction. Kneeling is a traditional congregational response, not a reason to imitate every priestly motion leading up to the blessing.","spiritual_fr":"La bénédiction renvoie les fidèles du sacrifice sous la bénédiction de Dieu. S’agenouiller est une réponse traditionnelle des fidèles, non une raison d’imiter chaque mouvement sacerdotal qui précède la bénédiction.","variation_en":"The final blessing is omitted in a Requiem; suppress the associated posture guidance there.","variation_fr":"La bénédiction finale est omise dans un Requiem ; supprimez alors l’indication de posture associée.","sources":["gueranger"]},"last-gospel":{"spiritual_en":"The Prologue of St John places the mystery of the Incarnation at the threshold of departure. The genuflection at Et Verbum caro factum est is therefore a final bodily confession of the Word made flesh.","spiritual_fr":"Le Prologue de saint Jean place le mystère de l’Incarnation au seuil du départ. La génuflexion à Et Verbum caro factum est est donc une dernière confession corporelle du Verbe fait chair.","variation_en":"A proper Last Gospel can replace John 1 on the days where the 1962 books prescribe it; in that case the John 1 genuflection does not occur.","variation_fr":"Un Dernier Évangile propre peut remplacer Jean 1 aux jours où les livres de 1962 le prescrivent ; dans ce cas, la génuflexion de Jean 1 n’a pas lieu.","sources":["gueranger"]}};
const EXTRA={"gueranger":{"label":"Dom Prosper Guéranger · Explanation of the Holy Mass","label_fr":"Dom Prosper Guéranger · Explication de la Sainte Messe","kind":"Traditional spiritual commentary","kind_fr":"Commentaire spirituel traditionnel","note":"Used for spiritual and symbolic interpretation of the ceremonies; not treated as a controlling 1962 rubric or as proof of historical origin.","note_fr":"Utilisé pour l’interprétation spirituelle et symbolique des cérémonies ; il n’est pas traité comme rubrique normative de 1962 ni comme preuve d’origine historique."},"alphonsus":{"label":"St Alphonsus / Grimm · The Holy Mass","label_fr":"Saint Alphonse / Grimm · La Sainte Messe","kind":"Traditional ascetical commentary","kind_fr":"Commentaire ascétique traditionnel","note":"Used for interior disposition and ascetical participation; ceremonial details are accepted only where independently compatible with the 1962 books.","note_fr":"Utilisé pour les dispositions intérieures et la participation ascétique ; les détails cérémoniels ne sont retenus que lorsqu’ils sont indépendamment compatibles avec les livres de 1962."},"wapelhorst":{"label":"Wapelhorst · Compendium Sacrae Liturgiae","label_fr":"Wapelhorst · Compendium Sacrae Liturgiae","kind":"Traditional ceremonial reference","kind_fr":"Référence cérémonielle traditionnelle","note":"Used as a supporting witness for traditional ceremonial categories such as name bows; it does not turn clerical ceremonial into universal lay law.","note_fr":"Utilisé comme témoin complémentaire pour des catégories cérémonielles traditionnelles telles que les inclinations aux noms ; il ne transforme pas le cérémonial clérical en loi universelle pour les fidèles."}};
globalThis.AO_FORMATION_NOTES_V4314=Object.freeze(NOTES);
if(globalThis.AO_LEARN_SOURCES)Object.assign(globalThis.AO_LEARN_SOURCES,EXTRA);
if(globalThis.AO_LEARN_ENRICHMENT && !globalThis.AO_LEARN_ENRICHMENT['super-populum'])globalThis.AO_LEARN_ENRICHMENT['super-populum']={what:'On the appropriate penitential days, a distinct Prayer over the People follows the Postcommunion and dismissal dialogue according to the proper rubrics.',what_fr:'Aux jours pénitentiels appropriés, une Oraison sur le peuple distincte suit la Postcommunion et le dialogue de renvoi selon les rubriques propres.',meaning:'The prayer extends the Church’s supplication over the people before the conclusion of the rite.',meaning_fr:'Cette oraison prolonge la supplication de l’Église sur le peuple avant la conclusion du rite.',sources:['mr1962','oconnell1964']};
const inspect=()=>{const g=globalThis.AO_MASS_GUIDANCE_V4313,learn=globalThis.AO_UNDERSTAND_MASS;const checks={baseGuidance:!!g&&g.inspect?.().pass===true,formationNotes:Object.keys(NOTES).length>=25,learnOpenStep:typeof learn?.openStep==='function',superPopulum:!!globalThis.AO_LEARN_ENRICHMENT?.['super-populum'],guerangerSource:!!globalThis.AO_LEARN_SOURCES?.gueranger,alphonsusSource:!!globalThis.AO_LEARN_SOURCES?.alphonsus};return{version:'43.14',pass:Object.values(checks).every(Boolean),checks,counts:{formationNotes:Object.keys(NOTES).length,learnSources:Object.keys(globalThis.AO_LEARN_SOURCES||{}).length}}};
globalThis.AO_MASS_FORMATION_V4314=Object.freeze({version:'43.14',notes:NOTES,inspect});globalThis.AO_V4314_META=Object.freeze({version:'43.14',title:'Ad Orientem 2.0 v43.14 — Mass Formation Guides',base:'v43.13',lane:'mass-formation-guides',inspect});document.title='Ad Orientem 2.0 v43.14 — Mass Formation Guides';document.documentElement.dataset.aoRelease='43.14';
})();

<style id="ao-v4315-mobile-guide-qa-css">
/* v43.15 — presentation-only mobile hardening for Mass formation / cue guide sheets. */
.whySheet,.whySheet *{min-width:0}
.whySheet{scrollbar-gutter:stable;overflow-x:hidden}
.whySheet .whyBlock,.whySheet .whyDetail,.whySheet .whyDetailBody,.whySheet .whySources li{overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:normal}
.whySummaryLabel{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.aoGuideFact span,.aoLearnGuideFact span,.aoGuideFact small,.aoLearnGuideFact small{overflow-wrap:anywhere}

/* The compact cue guide previously inherited browser-default UL/status styling. */
.aoCueGuideSources{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:8px}
.aoCueGuideSources li{margin:0;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.022);color:var(--text);font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.35;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.aoCueGuideSources small{display:block;color:var(--liturgical);font:600 .58rem/1.2 var(--font-display);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.065em;margin:0 0 4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.aoCueGuideStatus{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;max-width:100%;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid var(--liturgical-border);border-radius:999px;background:var(--liturgical-soft);color:var(--text);font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.3;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.aoCueGuideCaution{margin:0;color:var(--muted-2)!important;font-size:.82rem!important;line-height:1.45!important}
.aoCueStudy{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:10px 12px;line-height:1.25;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

/* Full-sheet source cards and authority notes remain readable at narrow widths. */
.whySources a,.whySources b,.sourceLocator,.authorityNote{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.whyDetail>summary{min-width:0}

@media(max-width:480px){
  .sheetBackdrop{padding-left:max(0px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(0px,env(safe-area-inset-right))}
  .liveSheet.whySheet{max-height:92dvh;padding-left:14px;padding-right:14px}
  .liveSheet.whySheet header{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 44px;gap:8px}
  .liveSheet.whySheet header h2{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  .whyDetail>summary{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto 18px;gap:7px;min-height:52px}
  .whySummaryMeta{max-width:40vw;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .aoGuideFact,.aoLearnGuideFact{grid-template-columns:minmax(62px,auto) minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 8px;padding:9px}
  .whySources li{padding:10px}
}

@media(max-width:360px){
  .liveSheet.whySheet{max-height:94dvh;padding:14px 12px calc(18px + var(--safe-bottom))}
  .liveSheet.whySheet header{top:-14px;padding:14px 0 9px}
  .liveSheet.whySheet header h2{font-size:1.12rem;line-height:1.22}
  .whyBlock{padding:11px 0}
  .primaryWhy p{font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.52}
  .whyDetail{margin-top:8px;padding:0 10px}
  .whyDetail>summary{min-height:50px;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto 17px;gap:6px;font-size:.67rem;letter-spacing:.055em}
  .whySummaryMeta{max-width:34vw;padding:4px 6px;font-size:.54rem}
  .whyDetailBody{padding-bottom:13px}
  .whyDetailBody>p{font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.52}
  .aoGuideFact,.aoLearnGuideFact{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:3px;padding:9px 10px}
  .aoGuideFact small,.aoLearnGuideFact small{grid-column:1}
  .aoGuideFact b,.aoLearnGuideFact b{margin-bottom:1px}
  .authorityNote{padding:9px 10px}
  .aoCueGuideStatus{border-radius:10px}
  .aoCueStudy{margin-bottom:calc(8px + var(--safe-bottom))}
}

@media(max-width:320px){
  .whySummaryMeta{display:none}
  .whyDetail>summary{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 17px}
  .whyDetail>summary:after{grid-column:2}
}
</style>

 return {ok:true,reason:'approved'};

}

 if(!r||r.status!=='GREEN'||!r.primaryArtId)return '';

 const a=effectiveArtwork(r.primaryArtId);if(!a||!a.file||!a.sourcePage)return '';

 const attr=attribution&&/^CC BY/i.test(license)&&!attribution.toLowerCase().includes('cc by')?`${attribution} · ${license}`:(attribution||license);
 const alt=`${a.artist||''} — ${a.title||r.label||''}`;
 const ratio=(Number(a.width)||1)/(Number(a.height)||1),orientation=ratio<0.82?'isPortrait':ratio>1.22?'isLandscape':'isBalanced';
 const src=thumb(a.file,1280),s800=thumb(a.file,768),s1800=thumb(a.file,1800);
 return `<figure class="aoProperArt ${orientation}" data-ao-proper-art="${esc(r.primaryArtId)}" data-proper-path="${esc(path)}"><div class="aoProperArtMedia"><img src="${esc(src)}" srcset="${esc(s800)} 768w, ${esc(src)} 1280w, ${esc(s1800)} 1800w" sizes="(max-width:560px) 100vw, 720px" alt="${esc(alt)}" loading="eager" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.closest('figure')?.remove()"></div><figcaption><span><strong>${esc(a.artist||'')}</strong>${a.title?` · ${esc(a.title)}`:''}${attr?`<br><small>${esc(attr)}</small>`:''}</span><a href="${esc(a.sourcePage)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='fr'?'Source':'Source'} ↗</a></figcaption></figure>`;
}
function homeMarkup(state,lang='en'){
 const path=art.properPath(state),r=effectiveRow(path);
 if(!r||r.status!=='GREEN'||!r.primaryArtId)return '';
 if(ROWS[path])return renderRow(path,r,lang);
 return aestheticStatus(r.primaryArtId).ok?priorHomeMarkup(state,lang):'';
}
function inspect(){
 const rows=effectiveRows(),arts=effectiveArtworks(),vals=Object.values(rows);
 const active=vals.filter(r=>r?.status==='GREEN'&&r.primaryArtId);
 const blockedActive=active.filter(r=>BLOCKED_IDS.has(String(r.primaryArtId))).map(r=>({path:r.properPath,id:r.primaryArtId}));
 const prohibitedActive=active.filter(r=>{const a=arts[r.primaryArtId];return a&&BANNED_MEDIUM.test(String(a.medium||''))&&!ART_META[r.primaryArtId]?.aestheticApproved&&!a.aestheticApproved}).map(r=>({path:r.properPath,id:r.primaryArtId,medium:arts[r.primaryArtId]?.medium||''}));
 const unapprovedActive=active.filter(r=>!aestheticStatus(r.primaryArtId).ok).map(r=>({path:r.properPath,id:r.primaryArtId,reason:aestheticStatus(r.primaryArtId).reason}));
 const checks={blockedActive:blockedActive.length===0,prohibitedMediumActive:prohibitedActive.length===0,allActiveApproved:unapprovedActive.length===0,tomorrowFailsClosed:rows['Tempora/Pent17-0']?.status==='NO_ART',lostSheepReplacement:rows['Tempora/Pent03-0']?.primaryArtId==='AO100',paralyticReplacement:rows['Tempora/Pent18-0']?.primaryArtId==='AO153'};
 return {version:'43.12',pass:Object.values(checks).every(Boolean),counts:{rows:vals.length,green:active.length,noArt:vals.filter(r=>r?.status==='NO_ART').length},checks,blockedActive,prohibitedActive,unapprovedActive,overrides:ROWS,newArtwork:NEW_ART['AO153']};
}

art.effectiveRow=effectiveRow;
art.effectiveRows=effectiveRows;
art.effectiveArtwork=effectiveArtwork;
art.effectiveArtworks=effectiveArtworks;
art.homeMarkup=homeMarkup;
art.closureBatch='SACRED-ART-AESTHETIC-GATE-v43.12';
art.aestheticStatus=aestheticStatus;

globalThis.AO_SACRED_ART_AESTHETIC_V4312=Object.freeze({version:'43.12',policy:'MANUAL_AESTHETIC_APPROVAL_REQUIRED',blockedIds:Object.freeze([...BLOCKED_IDS]),rows:ROWS,newArtwork:NEW_ART['AO153'],reusedArtwork:'AO100',retainedExceptions:ART_META,inspect,aestheticStatus});

<style id="ao-v4313-presentation-ownership-css">
/* v43.13 — one mobile width owner for primary surfaces. */
html,body,#app{max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip}
.homeScreen,.liveScreen,.flowScreen,.scriptureScreen,#aoPrayerBookRoot,.aoV37Root{max-inline-size:100%}
.homeScreen>*,.liveScreen>*,.flowScreen>*,.scriptureScreen>*{min-inline-size:0;max-inline-size:100%}

/* HOME — canonical domain dock supersedes the older Mass Details / More cards. */
.homeScreen{overflow-x:clip!important}
.homeScreen .contentCard,.homeScreen .statusCard,.homeScreen .resumeCard,.homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav{width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important}
.homeScreen .contentCard>*,.homeScreen .massCard>*,.homeScreen .moreCard>*,.homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav>*{min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important}
.homeScreen .massCard,.homeScreen .moreCard{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto!important}
.homeScreen :is(.contentCard,.massCard,.moreCard,.aoV37HomeNav) :is(h1,h2,h3,p,b,span){overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.homeScreen:has(.aoV37HomeNav)>.massCard,
.homeScreen:has(.aoV37HomeNav)>.moreCard{display:none!important}
.homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav{overflow:hidden!important}
.homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav .aoV37DomainDock{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
.homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav .aoV37DomainDock button{min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important;overflow:hidden!important}
.homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav .aoV37DomainDock button b,
.homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav .aoV37DomainDock button span{white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.homeScreen .aoV37UtilityRail{max-width:100%!important;overflow:hidden!important}
@media(max-width:480px){
 .homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav{padding:11px!important}
 .homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav .aoV37DomainDock{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:8px!important}
 .homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav .aoV37DomainDock button{min-height:58px!important;padding:8px 6px!important}
 .homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav .aoV37DomainDock button b{font-size:.86rem!important}
 .homeScreen .aoV37HomeNav .aoV37DomainDock button span{font-size:.54rem!important}
}

/* LIVE MASS — preserve Schola identity, but long Proper text remains reading text. */
.massTexts,.massReading,.swapSurface,.massText{min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important}
.choirReading .massText{max-width:36rem!important;margin-inline:auto!important;text-align:left!important;font-size:clamp(1.12rem,5.4vw,1.28rem)!important;line-height:1.55!important;letter-spacing:0!important;text-wrap:pretty}
.choirReading .rolePassage,.choirReading .liturgicalParagraphGroup{text-align:left!important}
.choirReading .scriptureReference{text-align:left!important;margin-bottom:.55em!important}
.choirReading .chantVerseLine{justify-content:flex-start!important;max-width:36rem!important;margin-left:0!important;margin-right:0!important}
.swapAction{width:max-content!important;max-width:100%!important;min-height:34px!important;margin:12px auto 0!important;padding:7px 11px!important;border:1px solid var(--border)!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)!important;color:var(--liturgical)!important;font:650 .6rem/1.1 var(--font-display)!important;letter-spacing:.055em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important}
.swapAction:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--liturgical)!important;outline-offset:3px!important}
.aoInlineCue{max-width:min(100%,15rem)!important;white-space:normal!important;line-height:1.2!important;vertical-align:baseline!important}
@media(max-width:390px){
 .choirReading .massText{font-size:1.12rem!important;line-height:1.5!important}
 .aoInlineCue{font-size:.49rem!important;padding:3px 6px!important;gap:4px!important}
 .aoInlineCue img{width:16px!important;height:16px!important}
}

/* PRAYER / STATIONS — one inline-size contract; prayer corpus is untouched. */
#aoPrayerBookRoot{overflow-x:hidden!important;max-width:100vw!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .pbShell{box-sizing:border-box!important;width:100%!important;max-width:820px!important;min-width:0!important;margin-inline:auto!important;padding-left:clamp(12px,4vw,18px)!important;padding-right:clamp(12px,4vw,18px)!important;overflow-x:clip!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .pbShell>*,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet>*,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-text,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-text>*,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoPrayerBundleItem{box-sizing:border-box!important;min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoPrayerBundleItem{display:block!important;width:100%!important;margin:16px 0!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip{display:block!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;width:100%!important;inline-size:100%!important;min-width:0!important;min-inline-size:0!important;max-width:100%!important;max-inline-size:100%!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;white-space:normal!important;word-break:normal!important;overflow-wrap:break-word!important;text-align:left!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip>[data-pb-latin],
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip>[data-pb-vern],
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip .aoPrayerProse,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip .aoCustomarySplit,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip .aoPrayerDialogueLine{display:block!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important;white-space:normal!important;word-break:normal!important;overflow-wrap:break-word!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip .aoPrayerDialogueLine{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1.55rem minmax(0,1fr)!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoPrayerDialogueBody,#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoPrayerWords{min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important;white-space:normal!important;word-break:normal!important;overflow-wrap:break-word!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-text h2,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-text h3,
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoPrayerBundleItem>.eyebrow{max-width:100%!important;white-space:normal!important;word-break:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-text h3{font-size:clamp(.94rem,4.2vw,1.08rem)!important;line-height:1.28!important;letter-spacing:.045em!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-rail{max-width:100%!important;overscroll-behavior-inline:contain!important}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-flip-hint{max-width:100%!important;white-space:normal!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important}
@media(max-width:430px){
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet{padding:15px!important}
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip{font-size:1.04rem!important;line-height:1.56!important}
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-text h3{margin-top:18px!important}
}
</style>

<style id="ao-v4313-tier-a-icons-css">
.aoUiIcon{width:1.25em;height:1.25em;display:inline-block;flex:none;overflow:visible;color:currentColor;stroke:currentColor;vertical-align:-.2em}
.aoUiIconOnly{display:inline-grid!important;place-items:center!important}
.aoUiIconOnly>.aoUiIcon{width:22px;height:22px;vertical-align:0}
.aoUiIconLead,.aoUiIconTrail{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:.42em!important}
.aoUiIconLead>.aoUiIcon,.aoUiIconTrail>.aoUiIcon{width:1.05em;height:1.05em}
.liveBackButton,.liveNextButton{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:6px!important}
.liveNextButton{justify-content:flex-end!important}
.liveBackButton>.aoUiIcon,.liveNextButton>.aoUiIcon{width:18px;height:18px}
.aoV37UtilityRail button.aoUiIconLead{display:inline-flex!important}
.aoUiExternal{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:.3em!important}
.aoUiExternal>.aoUiIcon{width:.9em;height:.9em}
.aoUiDisclosure{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:.45em!important}
.aoUiDisclosure>.aoUiIcon{margin-left:auto;transition:transform .18s ease}
details[open]>.aoUiDisclosure>.aoUiIcon{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.aoUiSelected{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:.32em!important}
.aoUiSelected>.aoUiIcon{width:.88em;height:.88em}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.aoUiDisclosure>.aoUiIcon{transition:none}}
</style>
<script id="ao-v4313-tier-a-icons-js">
(()=>{'use strict';
const VERSION='43.13-TIER-A-BATCH-1';
const IDS=Object.freeze(['ao-ui-home','ao-ui-back','ao-ui-close','ao-ui-previous','ao-ui-next','ao-ui-search','ao-ui-settings','ao-ui-info','ao-ui-sources','ao-ui-external','ao-ui-check','ao-ui-expand']);
const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';let storeHooked=false,queued=false,timer=0;
function icon(id,extra=''){const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');svg.classList.add('aoUiIcon');if(extra)extra.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).forEach(c=>svg.classList.add(c));svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');svg.setAttribute('focusable','false');const use=document.createElementNS(NS,'use');use.setAttribute('href','#'+id);svg.appendChild(use);return svg}
function removeLegacyVisual(el){el.querySelectorAll(':scope > img.navIcon,:scope > img.smallNavIcon,:scope > .aoUiIcon').forEach(n=>n.remove());[...el.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===Node.TEXT_NODE&&/^[\s×‹›←→•••]+$/.test(n.nodeValue||'')).forEach(n=>n.remove())}
function iconOnly(el,id,label){if(!el)return;removeLegacyVisual(el);el.classList.add('aoUiIconOnly');el.dataset.aoTierAIcon=id;if(!el.getAttribute('aria-label'))el.setAttribute('aria-label',label||id);el.prepend(icon(id));}
function lead(el,id){if(!el)return;el.querySelectorAll(':scope > .aoUiIcon,:scope > img.navIcon,:scope > img.smallNavIcon').forEach(n=>n.remove());el.classList.add('aoUiIconLead');el.dataset.aoTierAIcon=id;el.prepend(icon(id));}
function trail(el,id){if(!el||el.querySelector(':scope > .aoUiIcon'))return;el.classList.add('aoUiIconTrail');el.dataset.aoTierAIcon=id;el.append(icon(id));}
function prevNext(el,id,side){if(!el)return;el.querySelectorAll(':scope > .aoUiIcon').forEach(n=>n.remove());[...el.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===Node.TEXT_NODE&&/[←→‹›]/.test(n.nodeValue||'')).forEach(n=>{n.nodeValue=(n.nodeValue||'').replace(/[←→‹›]/g,'')});el.classList.add(side==='lead'?'aoUiIconLead':'aoUiIconTrail');if(side==='lead')el.prepend(icon(id));else el.append(icon(id));el.dataset.aoTierAIcon=id}
function syncSelected(){document.querySelectorAll('.aoUiSelected').forEach(el=>{el.classList.remove('aoUiSelected');el.querySelectorAll(':scope > svg[data-ao-selected-icon]').forEach(n=>n.remove())});document.querySelectorAll('.homeSegments button.active,.segmented button.active').forEach(el=>{if(el.querySelector(':scope > .aoUiIcon'))return;const i=icon('ao-ui-check');i.dataset.aoSelectedIcon='1';el.prepend(i);el.classList.add('aoUiSelected')})}
function externalLinks(){document.querySelectorAll('.aoProperArt figcaption a[target="_blank"],.sourceOpen[target="_blank"],.sourceLink[target="_blank"],.whySources a[target="_blank"]').forEach(el=>{if(el.querySelector(':scope > .aoUiIcon'))return;[...el.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===Node.TEXT_NODE).forEach(n=>n.nodeValue=(n.nodeValue||'').replace(/\s*↗\s*$/,' '));el.classList.add('aoUiExternal');el.append(icon('ao-ui-external'));el.dataset.aoTierAIcon='ao-ui-external'})}
function disclosures(){document.querySelectorAll('.whyDetail>summary,.sourceNote>summary,.provenance>summary,.readerWarnings>summary').forEach(el=>{if(el.querySelector(':scope > .aoUiIcon'))return;el.classList.add('aoUiDisclosure');el.append(icon('ao-ui-expand'));el.dataset.aoTierAIcon='ao-ui-expand'})}
function scan(){
 iconOnly(document.querySelector('[data-live-home]'),'ao-ui-home','Home');
 iconOnly(document.querySelector('[data-live-sheet="settings"]'),'ao-ui-settings','Settings');
 document.querySelectorAll('button[data-scripture-close]').forEach(el=>iconOnly(el,'ao-ui-back',globalThis.AO_RUNTIME_V8?.store?.getState?.()?.language==='fr'?'Retour':'Back'));
 document.querySelectorAll('button[data-home-sheet-close],button[data-ao-close],button[data-auditclose],button[aria-label="Close"],button[aria-label="Fermer"]').forEach(el=>iconOnly(el,'ao-ui-close',globalThis.AO_RUNTIME_V8?.store?.getState?.()?.language==='fr'?'Fermer':'Close'));
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-live-prev],[data-pb-station-prev]').forEach(el=>prevNext(el,'ao-ui-previous','lead'));
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-live-next],[data-pb-station-next]').forEach(el=>prevNext(el,'ao-ui-next','trail'));
 document.querySelectorAll('button[data-v37-open="utility.sources"]').forEach(el=>lead(el,'ao-ui-sources'));
 document.querySelectorAll('button[data-v37-open="utility.settings"],button[data-home-open-settings]').forEach(el=>lead(el,'ao-ui-settings'));
 document.querySelectorAll('button[data-cate-view="search"]').forEach(el=>lead(el,'ao-ui-search'));
 document.querySelectorAll('button.whyButton,button[data-live-sheet="why"]').forEach(el=>lead(el,'ao-ui-info'));
 externalLinks();disclosures();syncSelected();document.documentElement.dataset.aoTierAIcons='batch1';
}
function queue(){if(!queued){queued=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{queued=false;scan()})}clearTimeout(timer);timer=setTimeout(scan,180)}
function installStore(){const store=globalThis.AO_RUNTIME_V8?.store;if(!store?.subscribe||storeHooked)return;storeHooked=true;store.subscribe(queue)}
function init(){scan();installStore();document.addEventListener('click',queue,true);document.addEventListener('change',queue,true);document.addEventListener('submit',queue,true);[80,240,700,1600,3400].forEach(ms=>setTimeout(()=>{installStore();scan()},ms));globalThis.AO_TIER_A_ICONS_V4313=Object.freeze({version:VERSION,ids:IDS,scan,inspect:()=>({version:VERSION,symbols:IDS.length,hydrated:document.querySelectorAll('[data-ao-tier-a-icon]').length,observerFree:![...document.scripts].some(s=>/new\s+MutationObserver\s*\(/.test(s.textContent||''))})})}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
